# disASTER

> A short newsletter by Damien Herlihy on language, learning, and the beautiful mess of teaching.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dis-aster.vercel.app/): what disASTER is, and the subscribe form
- [Privacy](https://dis-aster.vercel.app/privacy): what the site collects (your email, only if you subscribe), what it doesn't, and how to leave
